Routine check. Vitals within her usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.

Seen at partner hospital emergency department on Sep 18, 2026 for urinary tract infection with acute confusion; treated and released the same day. Discharged on nitrofurantoin 100 MG for 5 days. Follow up with PACE primary care within 7 days.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Tajuana in good spirits.
Post-hospital follow-up for urinary tract infection with acute confusion. Tajuana is back to baseline per her son. Reviewed discharge medications. Will monitor closely over the next two weeks.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.

Tajuana reported a fall at home on Oct 2, 2026 in the bathroom at night. Her son Robert found her on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. Small skin tear to left forearm, cleaned and dressed. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.

PT evaluation following fall on Oct 2, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.

Met with Robert, Tajuana's son and primary caregiver. Robert reports exhaustion and poor sleep, and is worried about managing evenings alone. Requests respite. Discussed respite options and caregiver support group.
Tajuana needed hands-on help getting out of the tub today and said she has been skipping showers because she is afraid of slipping.

ADL reassessment. Tajuana now needs moderate assistance with bathing and lower-body dressing; independent at last review. Recommend tub transfer bench, handheld shower, and increasing home care hours for bathing support.
